label: Huawei OceanProtect X8000 backup storage (2U, 2 controllers)
description: Huawei OceanProtect X8000 all-flash/backup-storage node: one 2 U controller enclosure with two controllers (A and B), six interface-module slots per controller. Modelled configuration: a 4-port 10GE electrical interface module in IOM 0 (backup and replication data) and another in IOM 1 (container front-end control) on each controller - 16 x 10GbE SFP+ front-end ports in total, no PoE.
notes: Every field traces to Huawei documentation read 2026-11-17. (1) Module port count: 'A 10GE electrical interface module provides four 10 Gbit/s electrical ports' - OceanProtect X6000, X8000 1.3.0 Product Description (with Data Backup Features), EDOC1100319420, section '10GE Electrical Interface Module' (https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/doc/EDOC1100319420/7a0c3635/10ge-electrical-interface-module); the electrical module is an SFP+ per that page's Table 4-4. (2) Slot count and slot roles: 'Each of controllers A and B provides six interface module slots' and 'Interface modules for the front-end network connection can be installed only in slots IOM 0, IOM 1, and IOM 4'; IOM 0 takes the 10GE electrical module 'or a SmartIO interface module with a 10 Gbit/s or 25 Gbit/s optical module', IOM 1 takes a container front-end module ('Ports P0 and P1 ... P2 ... P3'), IOM 3 must hold the 25 Gbit/s RoCE module with no cable, IOM 4 is optional - OceanProtect X6000, X8000 1.3.0 Installation Guide (with Data Backup Feature), EDOC1100318730, section 'Cabinet Layout and Connection Planning' (https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/doc/EDOC1100318730/ce945100/cabinet-layout-and-connection-planning). (3) Two controllers and the 2 U / 12-disk and 2 U / 25-disk enclosure variants: Product Description EDOC1100319420 (sections '2 U Controller Enclosure', 'Indicators') and the same Installation Guide's Table 4-2. NOT MODELLED, deliberately: IOM 4 (optional per the guide, and the two document versions disagree on whether it takes front-end or 12 Gbit/s SAS modules), the 25 Gbit/s RoCE module in IOM 3 and the 25 Gbit/s RDMA module in IOM 2 (both are internal or inter-enclosure links with no cable to an application server - the guide says of IOM 3 'no cable connection is required'), the 12 Gbit/s SAS expansion modules in IOM 3/4/5 (disk enclosures, not Ethernet), and the controller's management network port (the rear-panel indicator table names it once per controller, but its count and rate appear only in figures). The sibling OceanProtect X9000 is NOT in this spec: its Product Description is unreachable (see research/oceanprotect-x-series-port-census.md), so issue #741 is only partly answered by this entry.
